title: MCP Tools Schema for AI Chatbot
description: Defines the MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools available to the OpenAI agent for task management. All tools require user_id parameter for authorization and data isolation.

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Creates a new todo task for the authenticated user. Use this when the user asks to add, create, or remind them about something.

user_id.description: UUID of the authenticated user (extracted from JWT). This ensures tasks are created for the correct user.

title.description: Title of the task. Extract the main action or item from the user's message. Example: 'Buy groceries', 'Call mom', 'Finish report'.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the task. Use this for additional context provided by the user.

task_id.description: UUID of the newly created task

description.description: Description of the created task (if provided)

created_at.description: Timestamp when the task was created

errors.description: Title is empty or exceeds 200 characters
Failed to create task in database

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Retrieves all tasks for the authenticated user. Use this when the user asks to see, show, list, or view their tasks or todos.

user_id.description: UUID of the authenticated user (extracted from JWT)

filter_completed.description: Optional filter: true = only completed tasks, false = only incomplete tasks, null/undefined = all tasks. Default is null.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when task was last updated

errors.description: Failed to retrieve tasks from database

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Updates the title or description of an existing task. Use this when the user asks to change, edit, update, or modify a task.

user_id.description: UUID of the authenticated user (extracted from JWT)

task_id.description: UUID of the task to update. If the user refers to a task by title, first call list_tasks to find the task_id.

title.description: New title for the task (optional). Only provide if the user wants to change the title.

description.description: New description for the task (optional). Only provide if the user wants to change the description.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the task was last updated

errors.description: Task with the given task_id does not exist or does not belong to the user
Title is empty or exceeds 200 characters
Failed to update task in database

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Permanently deletes a task. Use this when the user asks to delete, remove, or get rid of a task.

user_id.description: UUID of the authenticated user (extracted from JWT)

task_id.description: UUID of the task to delete. If the user refers to a task by title, first call list_tasks to find the task_id.

message.example: Task 'Buy groceries' has been deleted successfully.

errors.description: Task with the given task_id does not exist or does not belong to the user
Failed to delete task from database

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Marks a task as completed. Use this when the user says they finished, completed, or are done with a task.

user_id.description: UUID of the authenticated user (extracted from JWT)

task_id.description: UUID of the task to mark as complete. If the user refers to a task by title, first call list_tasks to find the task_id.

is_completed.description: Completion status (should be true after this operation)

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the task was marked complete

errors.description: Task with the given task_id does not exist or does not belong to the user
Task is already marked as completed
Failed to update task status in database

userIdIsolation.description: All tools MUST enforce user_id filtering. The user_id parameter is extracted from the JWT token and passed to each tool. Tools MUST NOT access or modify tasks belonging to other users.

inputValidation.description: All tool inputs MUST be validated according to their schema. Invalid inputs should return a VALIDATION_ERROR.

errorHandling.description: Tools MUST NOT expose internal errors (stack traces, database errors) to the agent. Return generic error messages and log details server-side.

agent_instructions: Always extract user_id from the JWT context before calling any tool.
When a user refers to a task by title (e.g., 'complete buy groceries'), first call list_tasks to find the task_id.
If multiple tasks match a user's description, ask for clarification before acting.
Provide conversational, helpful responses after tool execution (e.g., 'I've added buy groceries to your tasks!' instead of just returning JSON).
If a tool call fails, explain the error to the user in natural language without technical jargon.

tool_calling_examples.user_message: Add buy milk to my tasks
tool_calling_examples.agent_response: I've added 'Buy milk' to your tasks. It's now in your todo list!
You have 3 incomplete tasks: 1. Buy milk, 2. Call mom, 3. Finish report.
Great! I've marked 'Buy milk' as completed. Nice work!
